therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: mucosal protective agent / mucin secretion stimulation
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: salivary gland mucosal protection and saliva secretion enhancement
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with Sjögren's Syndrome experiencing xerostomia (dry mouth)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Overall Improvement Rate in Dry Mouth Symptoms at Weeks 2, 4, and 8

results.effect_size: Week 8: 46.9% (Rebamipide) vs 39.1% (Placebo); Week 4: 44.0% vs 27.1%; Week 2: 26.0% vs 20.0%
subgroup_findings: Week 2: Rebamipide 26.0% improvement vs Placebo 20.0% (95% CI overlap suggests no significant difference)
Week 4: Rebamipide 44.0% improvement vs Placebo 27.1% (95% CI overlap)
Week 8: Rebamipide 46.9% improvement vs Placebo 39.1% (95% CI overlap)
safety_signals: Herpes zoster (SAE): 1 patient in Rebamipide arm
